content.value: Consider the following dequeue of characters where DEQUE is a circular array which is (10) allocated six memory cells: LEFT:2, RIGHT=4, DEQUE: , A, C, D, , . Describe the dequeue while the following operations take place.
(i) F is added to the right of the dequeue
(ii) Two letters on the right are deleted.
(iii)K, L, and M are added to the left.
(iv)One letter on the left is deleted.
